text:
maria: Draft ready for final pass — https://docs.google.com/document/d/abc123

alex: skimmed — headline is strong but I think we should tighten the second paragraph. Suggest: "Redwood Inference reduces per-token latency by up to 40% in common gen workloads." Can we avoid an absolute phrasing?

jonah: need benchmark specifics. Which model/seq did we run? P50/P95? add a short callout: "P50 42ms, P95 130ms on A100 80GB" if that's accurate.

liz: +1 on avoiding absolutes. Legal: change "cuts" to "reduces" and add source line. Also replace "40%" with "up to 40%" unless we have consistent dataset. I'll approve after that.

maria: noted. I'll update doc now and flag the exact bench table in the appendix. Targeting EOD approval. Also planning webinar CTA in the post — want ops to confirm routing.

sam: for webinar/reg capture, please include hidden UTMs and set hubspot form hidden fields: `utm_source=company_blog`, `utm_campaign=go_live_may`. Also set owner to `events@redwood.com`. Example snippet:
```
<input type="hidden" name="utm_source" value="company_blog">
<input type="hidden" name="utm_campaign" value="go_live_may">
```

alex: wording tweak for CTA: "Join our 30-min demo — see latency and cost tradeoffs live." Shorter: "See latency & cost tradeoffs live — register for the demo." I'll paste as suggestion in the doc.

jonah: also add a small FAQ line about model fallbacks + dedicated tier: one sentence. Prod teams ask that.

maria: updated doc link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/def456 — added bench table and CTA copy. Liz/sam/jonah/alex please thumbs up here when final. Planning publish Wed 9AM PT.

liz: legal OK on wording change and "up to" qualifier. :white_check_mark:

sam: routing set, HubSpot form updated, owner assigned. :thumbsup:

alex: quick pass complete, done.

jonah: looks good from PM side. one tiny edit in FAQ. Done.

maria: perfect — scheduling publish + demo invite. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
